purpose: Frozen 248-task baseline; no learning or skill; original tool schemas
solver: Sequential coordinator, executor, reviewer; separate append-only role contexts

sources.warning: Tools are the currently used fixed-earth snapshot, including prior local adaptations. This is NOT a claim of byte-for-byte identity to the upstream EarthAgent release. The original string-or-array schema is preserved.

external_dependencies: Raster datasets are read from the supplied task directory; not copied or version-locked here.
Local environment is shared and recorded in environment-lock.json (v2 environment); future experiments must not mutate it for this version.
Local model weights and serving environment are external to this snapshot; cloud Flash results are not pooled with local 9B results.

evaluation.ground_truth: Host-only scoring after final submission; no GT feedback to solver
evaluation.prior_q93_array_run: Diagnostic experiment only; not a run of this frozen original-interface baseline

maintenance: Do not edit this version after sealing. Create v2 for behavior changes. No paid evaluation performed as part of the freeze.
changes_from_v1: Added 16 missing tasks from official autonomous-planning question/choices and host-only whitelist answers; retained other 232 tasks unchanged.
Accept TIFF/JPG/JPEG/PNG without visual-model input; non-image sidecars excluded in separate read-only staged inputs.
Separate environment with local imports needed by all 104 tool modules.
16 isolated subprocess workers with host-only shared cost reservations and no automatic retries.
changes_from_v2: Local Qwen3.5-9B replaces cloud Flash, native 262144 context, no visual input.
Explicit temperature 0.7; server chat template disables thinking.
Local request/usage ledger; cloud price calculation disabled. Solver prompts, tool schemas and task set unchanged.
